tasks.title: Watchdog + RTC endpoints + pet loop + wakealarm writes
tasks.prompt: (RETROSPECTIVE — shipped.) Handlers in internal/handlers/system.go (or sibling file in the same package). Routes registered in routes.go. The watchdog enable opens /dev/watchdog + starts a 5s pet goroutine; release on context cancel. RTC endpoints shell out to hwclock + write /sys/class/rtc/rtc0/wakealarm.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd hal && go test -v -run TestWatchdog ./internal/handlers/ && go test -v -run TestRTC ./internal/handlers/
